_comment: Row 343 battery. The gate executes the shipped cloud setup with python3.12-venv initially unavailable, and executes the canonical old/new host runbook excerpts against separate roots. M1 recreates the first-run ordering defect. M2/M3 remove one of the two archive transfers, while M4 removes the fail-closed shell bound. M5 restores the application-incompatible nested config reader, M6 restores the unrelated fallback directory, and M7 accepts the legacy nested shape. O1 is the asymmetry control: an application-written flat mapping containing both configured and intentionally blank entries remains healthy. The matching transform-control spec applies M1 to a parse-only test and must ESCAPE, proving M1 is caught by the runtime ordering assertion rather than shell syntax or collection failure.
subject: Row 343 -- fresh-host cloud setup and the documented old-to-new bring-up distinguish executable state from missing packages, archives, and configured directories

mutants.label: M1 the declared core group no longer installs python3.12-venv before the first venv attempt

M4 the new-host restore block continues after an unavailable archive transfer
